title: Pokemon Japanese Alcremie CHR 201/184 s8b VMAX Climax Character Rare

descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Alcremie (Mahoip) Character Rare 201/184 - s8b VMAX Climax

Japanese-language Character Rare (CHR) from Sword & Shield high class pack s8b "VMAX Climax". Card number 201/184, illustrated by OKACHEKE, (c) 2021 Pokemon.

- Pokemon: Alcremie (Fairy, 90 HP, Stage 1, evolves from Milcery)
- Rarity: Character Rare (CHR) - full-art illustrated scene
- Card number: 201/184
- Set: s8b VMAX Climax (Japanese)
- Illustrator: OKACHEKE
- Ungraded, raw single

Condition: Pulled and sleeved straight away, handled by the edges. Front and back are both photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.
